name: The Bet
source:
You will play as Doctor Sabra Kenton, who is happily waiting for her childhood friend, Ryan, to come back home after spending 5 years in jail. There is a lot of sexual situations. You can shape Sabra's personality to your desire as the game unfolds.

[From [url=https://vcproductions.itch.io/the-bet]Itch.io[/url]]
